_about: Rotations compared in the Rotation Lab. Patterns and area shares are from the 2014-15 cropping-pattern surveys in Bangladesh Rice Journal 21(2) (Nasim et al. 2017 and regional papers). Sow dates are trial dates or assumptions and need local review. Collected with AI help on 11 Nov 2026, not yet reviewed by the team's research lead.

haor.label: Boro - Fallow - Fallow
haor.share: 39.6% of the Sylhet region's cropped area; 45-88% in Sunamganj upazilas
haor.sowNote: Transplanting in the first week of January (trial date).

haor.label: Short-duration boro - Fallow - Fallow
haor.sowNote: Same transplanting date, a variety that ripens about three weeks earlier.

haor.label: Mustard, then deepwater Aman
haor.share: 0.35% of the Sylhet region (Mustard - B. Aman)
notModelled: Deepwater (broadcast) Aman rice is not modelled
haor.sowNote: Sowing date is an assumption: it depends on when the haor water leaves the field.

barind.label: Lentil - Fallow - T. Aman
barind.share: 0.6% of the Rajshahi region; the survey recommends lentil for single T. Aman land
barind.sowNote: Lentil sown in the last week of November (https://repo.mel.cgiar.org/items/2a84853a-e525-4533-b568-53ba48795b9e/full).

barind.label: Mustard - Boro - T. Aman
barind.sowNote: Mustard and late boro dates are assumptions fitted between the Aman harvest and the next Aman.

coast.label: Fallow - Fallow - T. Aman
coast.share: 26.8% of the Khulna region; the most common pattern in 17 of 25 upazilas

coast.label: Boro - Fallow - T. Aman
coast.share: about a third of Satkhira's cropped area (approximate)

coast.label: Sunflower - Fallow - T. Aman
coast.sowNote: Sunflower sown before 15 December, when coastal trials found less salt and more yield (https://library.dpird.wa.gov.au/fc_researchart/148).
